entities.name: Gabriel
entities.description: A dragon seeking to conquer the human realm who tortured Freya to force her to hatch a dragon egg.
entities.quote: the dragons were careless and the father(gabriel) and his men search for freya as without her the egg can't be hatched.

entities.name: Tedmond Duskmoor
entities.description: A powerful Duskmoor who defended Freya and her egg from Gabriel before being killed.
entities.quote: he was one of the strongest duskmoor(tedmond duskmoor) who killed the grandpa who was one of the stong of his kind too.and later the father killed that duskmoor too.

entities.name: Khalid
entities.description: A demon who manipulated Freya to obtain a powerful dragon child for his goal of destroying humanity.
entities.quote: he intentionally got physical with freya to have a child with dragon abilities,basically freya is one of those special dragond who can birth special dragons who are powerful

entities.name: Niharo
entities.description: The child of two scientists born with Freya's assistance.
entities.quote: so freya helped him giving birth their child (niharo) in exchange of helping them hatching the egg.

entities.name: Duskmoor
entities.description: A group tasked with defending the human realm against dragons.
entities.quote: here in 1494 the duskmoor finds out that dragons are here in the human realm living with them .and the secret wars started.

timeline_events.title: Duskmoor-Dragon Secret War
timeline_events.description: The Duskmoor discovered dragons in the human realm, leading to a war that the Duskmoor eventually won.
timeline_events.quote: here in 1494 the duskmoor finds out that dragons are here in the human realm living with them .and the secret wars started.

timeline_events.title: Birth of Pristine
timeline_events.description: Freya gave birth to her daughter Pristine while being held by Gabriel.
timeline_events.quote: in 1498,freya was sleeping and as she was pregnant she was sort of weak.so she couldn't hatch the egg and gabriel didn't know about the child.

timeline_events.title: Khalid finds Pristine
timeline_events.description: Khalid discovered Pristine and began raising her.
timeline_events.quote: in 1513 ,khalid found pristine(he didn't knew it was his own baby).he took her and she started living with him.

timeline_events.title: Hatching of the Dragon Egg
timeline_events.description: Scientists working with Freya and Gabriel successfully hatched the dragon egg.
timeline_events.quote: and when niharo was 10 years old,i mean in 1692,they succeed to hatch the egg,and it was the character.whose picture i gave you!
